## Mills | Lead magnet - all 16 industries (Zoho CRM)
**Webhook:** POST, form-urlencoded (what the site sends). The Respond nodes return JSON so the site sees a 200.
**Setup:**
1. Pick your Zoho CRM (OAuth2, your data center) and Gmail credentials on the two action nodes.
2. **Segmentation.** In Zoho create custom Lead fields: Industry (picklist, API name Industry_Segment) with the values: Agriculture, Automotive, Aviation, Chemicals, Cold Chain, Construction, Data Centers, Electronics & Telecom, Food & Beverage, Freight Forwarders, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Marine, Mining, Renewable Energy, Retail. And Priority (picklist: Hot, Normal; API name Priority). Then make one Custom View per industry filtered on that field.
3. The emails (checklist now, follow-ups on day 3 and day 7) are sent by the separate follow-up workflows in n8n/followups/, triggered from Zoho when this workflow creates the lead.
4. Set each industry owner's email in the OWNERS list in the code node; the team notification goes to that person.
5. Activate, then copy the **Production URL** into js/lead-magnet.js (WEBHOOK_URL_INDUSTRY).
**Test:** use the Test URL once, then switch to Production.
